skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental theories and principles of corporate finance, including financial decision-making, capital structure, and investment analysis.
Analyze financial statements and assess financial performance of companies.
Manage short-term and long-term assets and liabilities of a company.
Develop financial plans and strategies for companies.
Make informed financial decisions based on data analysis and financial models.
Communicate financial information effectively to stakeholders.
Evaluate financial information critically and provide recommendations.
Identify and solve financial problems using analytical tools and techniques.
Collaborate effectively in teams to complete financial projects.
Lead and manage financial teams and projects.
Adhere to ethical standards in financial decision-making and reporting.
Apply mathematical concepts to financial calculations and models.
Understand economic principles and their impact on financial decisions.
Prepare and analyze financial statements and reports.
Use statistical methods to analyze financial data.
Utilize software and tools for financial analysis and reporting.
